Removed: chlorphenamine and fatigue links, 'pollen allergy' kept as alias (MedlinePlus describes hay fever as a pollen allergy), signs list emptied (no retrieved source), ragweed, 'peak July/August', 'most common complication', antibiotic/pollution risks, cromoglicate eye-drop claim, steroid-spray onset, Devon ENT referral, NHS 111 same-day route. Kept: Frimley local prescribing change as clearly local. Several attributions rest on blended summaries (family history/complications: PMC reviews; asthma untreated-risk: Frimley-hosted Allergy UK leaflet; diagnosis: NHS Devon and a Barnsley leaflet of patient.info text). MedlinePlus 'most effective' kept attributed to MedlinePlus. Alias 'seasonal allergic rhinitis' now supported by Asthma + Lung UK. 999 line now supported by NHS Wales/Asthma + Lung UK. Immunotherapy 'few months before season' supported by NHS summary. 'Patient information site' sentence on early treatment rests on NHS inform/patient.info summary, not individually cited. Remaining doubt: first-pass search-sourced text for the 'NHS lists ... loss of smell' wording came from a blended NHS summary.
